headerDisplay: Connect RAPT devices to Homebridge. Cloud access needs an API secret created in the RAPT portal under My Account → API Secrets.

apiSecret.title: RAPT API secret
apiSecret.description: Create one in the RAPT portal under My Account → API Secrets. This is not your account password.

pollingInterval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to read telemetry from the RAPT cloud. The API is rate limited, so keep this modest.
